text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing with 
Kitasan Black, while shopping at the mall—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hmm? What's that...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I knew it, Inari-san!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, if it isn't Kitasan! If you've got 
some time, come on over!
choice_data_list: Drop by? What are you doing?
Drop by? What are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Since it's a special festival, I'm 
helping out at the food stall. Is there 
anything you folks fancy?"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Mmm! Any street stall food is—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah, honeycomb toffee!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ho-hoh, karumeyaki honeycomb candy? Quite 
the vintage taste! Are you sure you don't 
want something like a "kebab" or a 
"crepe"?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's been my favorite ever since I 
was little!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha, is that right, is that right! If you 
like it that much, Lady Inari will treat 
ya!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, are you sure? Thank you so much, 
I'll savor every bite!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Mmm, that was delicious!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I remember sharing things with my 
little brothers at the park just like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Whenever I went to festivals with my 
family back in the day, they'd always buy 
them for me!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dad, Mom, and my little brothers... I 
really loved eating honeycomb toffee 
together as a family.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, I wanted to eat it every 
day, throwing tantrums like, 'Why don't 
they sell this on normal days?'

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
And then, one of my father's apprentices 
told me, 'It's actually quite easy to 
make.' However—

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
Why isn't it exciting to eat the one I 
made like the ones at the festival?

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
But I wanna eat the same kind they had at 
the festival!

text_block_list.name: Apprentice
text_block_list.text: Chiyaji-san, that's just—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"The taste of food changes depending on 
where and who you eat it with," they say.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"That's how I realized. What I love is the 
honeycomb toffee I share with my dad and 
the others at the festival..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Eating at my favorite festival, with the 
people I love most. That's why it was so 
'special'.
choice_data_list: Is it a taste filled with memories?

You really love your dad and the others, 
don't you?

You really love your dad and the others, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Eating at my favorite festival, with the 
people I love most. That's why it was so 
'special'.
choice_data_list: Is it a taste filled with memories?

You really love your dad and the others, 
don't you?

You really love your dad and the others, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's a special, precious memory. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Today's flavor feels unforgettable as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Going on an outing with Trainer, having 
you listen to stories about the past... 
Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The sweetness back then was exciting, but 
today's... it somehow just warms my heart.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's eat honeycomb toffee 
together again sometime, okay?♪

And thus, a new memorable flavor was added 
to their memories.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Because in all my happy memories, Mom, 
Dad, and everyone in my family are always 
right there beside me!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We can't really go to festivals together 
right now, but I'd love to eat together as 
a family again...
choice_data_list: Why not make some for them?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, but won't my family feel like it 
doesn't taste like festival food, just 
like I did?
choice_data_list:
It's about "where" and "who you ate it 
with," right?

It's about "where" and "who you ate it 
with," right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
True! Eating "at home" and "all together" 
for the first time in a while might give 
it a brand new, special flavor!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"If that's the case, I need to practice 
making it so it turns out delicious!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Really? Then let's start with about 30 
servings!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, if you count all our apprentices, 
we're a huge family of dozens of people! 
Time to fire myself up~!"

I returned to the academy with Kitasan 
Black and made a huge batch of honeycomb 
toffee.
